stem_book: 2.5 moles of an ideal gas are expanded isothermally from 12 dm³ to 25 dm³ against a constant external pressure of 3.0 bar. Calculate the work obtained. (in kJ)
reason: printed key −3.95 kJ treats 3.0 bar as atm (×101.3 J); in bar, 1 bar dm³ = 100 J → −3.90 kJ; manifest key already −3.90
work: w = −P_ext ΔV = −3.0 bar × (25 − 12) dm³ = −39 bar dm³ = −3900 J = −3.90 kJ
